newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Daily News sees interim loss - papers.
newsitem.headline: HK Daily News sees interim loss - papers.

text.p: Hong Kong Daily News Holdings Ltd is expected to report an interim loss for the six months to September 30, Hong Kong newspapers on Tuesday quoted executive director Lun Siu-ming as saying.
The company's earnings were undermined by the legacy of a price war between Chinese-language newspapers, Lu said.
Lun was optimistic over the Daily News' earnings in the second half but he said it was still too early to predict whether it will be a net gain or loss, the reports said.
The company's officials were not immediately available for comment. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
